CustomField.description: System-written by MarketDataSnapshotService when this deal ENTERS underwriting approval (Underwriting_Status__c = 'Approved by Principals'). Not for manual entry. Frozen, composed, human-readable copy of every Property__c market value the principals saw at approval - evidentiary, not analytical. A re-approval re-snapshots deliberately. This field is NOT reportable or filterable per metric; that cost was accepted deliberately (Q1) in exchange for the live and frozen layers never drifting, since both are composed by one method.
CustomField.label: Market Data Snapshot
